title: Argo AI shuts down
text: Ford and Volkswagen wound down Argo AI in October 2022 after it could not attract new investors. Argo's reports in this dataset end that month.

title: Second amended SGO takes effect
text: NHTSA's second amended order took effect May 15, 2023. It added a five-day report for less serious crashes and revised the definition of an engaged automated system, so filing patterns before and after are not strictly comparable.

title: Cruise adds Dallas and Houston
text: Cruise added Dallas and Houston in May 2023, with safety drivers at first, after launching in Austin and Phoenix. By July it also operated in Miami and had announced Nashville. Its reports climb sharply from March through August 2023.

title: Cruise announces Nashville
text: By July 2023 Cruise had expanded to Austin, Dallas, Houston, Phoenix and Miami and announced Nashville next, putting more vehicles on the road just before its peak in reports.

title: San Francisco approves 24-hour paid robotaxis
text: On Aug. 10, 2023 the California Public Utilities Commission voted 3-1 to let Waymo and Cruise run paid driverless service across San Francisco at all hours, increasing miles driven in a dense city.

title: California suspends Cruise driverless permits
text: On Oct. 24, 2023 the California DMV suspended Cruise's deployment and driverless testing permits after a pedestrian was dragged by a Cruise vehicle. Cruise paused its San Francisco driverless operations, and no Cruise reports appear in this dataset after October 2023.

title: GM ends the Cruise robotaxi business
text: General Motors announced in December 2024 that it would stop funding Cruise's robotaxi service, ending the program.

title: May Mobility goes driverless in Peachtree Corners
text: May Mobility began fully driverless commercial rides in Peachtree Corners, Georgia in February 2025 after running with safety drivers since September 2024.

title: Waymo and Uber begin service in Austin
text: Waymo rides became available through the Uber app in Austin in March 2025, adding a new large market for Waymo's crash reports.

title: May Mobility partners with Uber
text: Uber and May Mobility announced a partnership on May 1, 2025, with an initial launch planned in Arlington, Texas, starting with human safety operators.

title: Aurora starts driverless trucking in Texas
text: Aurora began fully driverless freight runs between Dallas and Houston in late April and May 2025 with Uber Freight and Hirschbach Motor Lines.

title: Third amended SGO takes effect
text: NHTSA's third amended order, effective June 16, 2025, reduces duplicate filings and sets different reporting thresholds by automation type, so reports after this date are not strictly comparable.

title: Tesla starts its Austin robotaxi pilot
text: Tesla launched its Austin robotaxi pilot in mid-2025, with a safety monitor in the vehicle. Tesla's first ADS crash reports in this dataset begin in July 2025.

title: Waymo and Uber begin service in Atlanta
text: Waymo and Uber began robotaxi service in Atlanta in June 2025, covering about 65 square miles after Austin earlier in the year.

title: Aurora adds night driving and a Phoenix terminal
text: In July 2025 Aurora began driverless operations at night on the Dallas-Houston lane and opened a Phoenix terminal, more than doubling potential truck utilization.

title: Uber, Lucid and Nuro partner on a robotaxi
text: In July 2025 Uber invested in Lucid and committed to buy Lucid Gravity SUVs for a robotaxi program built on Nuro's driver, with testing in the San Francisco Bay Area.

title: Zoox opens Las Vegas to the public
text: Zoox began free public rides on the Las Vegas Strip in September 2025 in its purpose-built robotaxi, adding public service to its San Francisco testing.

title: Aurora extends driverless runs to El Paso
text: In October 2025 Aurora began driverless runs on the roughly 600-mile Fort Worth-El Paso route, about six months after its first driverless launch.

title: Waymo adds freeways and a larger Bay Area; five more cities go fully autonomous
text: On Nov. 12, 2025 Waymo began freeway trips for public riders in San Francisco, Los Angeles and Phoenix and extended its Bay Area service to about 260 square miles, down to San Jose. Days later it reported fully autonomous service in five more US cities. Freeways and new cities widen where Waymo's crashes are reported.

title: Avride launches on Uber in Dallas
text: Uber began matching riders with Avride robotaxis in Dallas on Dec. 3, 2025, with a specialist behind the wheel. Nearly all of Avride's reports come after this launch, and December 2025 is the first month with ten or more.

title: Zoox expands San Francisco and starts Austin and Miami
text: In March 2026 Zoox announced it would roughly quadruple its San Francisco area and begin operating purpose-built robotaxis in Austin and Miami, starting with employees. March 2026 is also its busiest month for reports.

title: Tesla expands unsupervised service area
text: By March 2026 Tesla had widened its unsupervised Austin service area, though only a small number of vehicles ran without a monitor. Remote supervision continues.

title: Motional relaunches on Uber in Las Vegas
text: Motional had paused commercial operations in 2024. On March 13, 2026 it returned on the Uber app in Las Vegas with a safety operator aboard, and aims to go driverless by the end of 2026.

title: Nuro begins Bay Area test rides for Uber staff
text: In April 2026 Nuro began test rides in the Lucid Gravity for Uber employees in the San Francisco Bay Area, still with a safety driver in front.
